title: When "Must" Becomes "Maybe": Constraint Weakening in LLM Agent Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2608.24569v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents coordinate complex tasks through multi-role and multi-stage workflows. Upstream state is repeatedly transformed into intermediate language artifacts, such as summaries, plans, tickets, memories, and handoff notes, from which downstream components act. For action-constraining state, topical retention is insufficient: an artifact may mention an unresolved condition while changing it from a requirement that must be resolved before execution into information that may merely inform the next action. We study this action-binding role as operational state preservation. Safety blockers provide a controlled instance because each source state has an explicit prerequisite, authority, fallback, and execution consequence. translated_title: 当“必须”变成“也许”：大语言模型智能体工作流中的约束弱化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体通过多角色和多阶段工作流协调复杂任务。上游状态被反复转换为中间语言产物，如摘要、计划、工单、记忆和交接说明，下游组件据此执行操作。对于约束行动的状态，仅保留主题是不够的：一个产物可能提到一个未解决的条件，但将其从执行前必须解决的硬性要求，转变为仅可能影响下一步行动的信息。我们研究这种行动绑定角色，将其视为操作状态保持。安全拦截器提供了一个受控实例，因为每个源状态都有明确的先决条件、权限、回退和执行后果。我们在上游识别正确的前提下，改变交接转换方式，并评估一个仅依赖所生成产物的执行器。在1，296个受控合成情节中，直接交接...
tldr: 本文揭示了大语言模型智能体工作流中，上游状态在交接转换时可能从“必须满足”的硬约束弱化为“仅供参考”的软信息，并提出了“操作状态保持”概念，通过安全拦截器场景下的1，296个受控实验系统研究了这一约束弱化现象。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that in LLM agent workflows, upstream state can be weakened from hard "must-satisfy" constraints to soft "may-inform" information during handoff transformations, and proposes the concept of "operational state preservation," systematically studying this constraint weakening through 1,296 controlled experiments in safety blocker scenarios.
